game_patch_basis: Live client as of the 19 Nov 2026 changelog; PTS (Black 2 / White 2) excluded
about: Authored PokeMMO availability registry. Separate axes: in_game_dex (does the species appear in PokeMMO's in-game Pokédex), acquisition classes (how it can be obtained), and evidence. Species not listed here get their classes derived at runtime from the user's locally installed dump (wild rows and evolution families), clearly labelled as dump-derived. Nothing here is per-account progress.

evidence_levels.OFFICIAL: Official PokeMMO changelog or support article
evidence_levels.CORROBORATED: Two independent sources, or PokeMMO-specific source plus in-game observation
evidence_levels.REPORTED: One PokeMMO-specific community source or owner report; may lag patches
evidence_levels.WALKTHROUGH: Mentioned in the owner's own PokeMMO walkthrough files (private, not redistributed)

observed_in_game.source: Owner's in-game National Pokédex recording, 22 Nov 2026 (video 3, 00:28-00:56), see docs/reviews/2026-11-22-three-video-audit.md
observed_in_game.note: Denominators of one client version on one date; they may change with patches. They are roster properties, not the owner's progress, and are only used for the difference report.
